title: Your First Weekend at Carroll University, Shared as Cards
description: A guide to the essential events and locations for new Pioneers during their first weekend on campus in Waukesha.

cards.title: Move-In Morning
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Check in at your assigned residence hall to receive your keys and Pioneer Card. Volunteers are available to help unload vehicles during designated time slots.
cards.short_summary: The official start of the first weekend where students move into campus housing.
cards.evidence_claim: First-year Student Move-In Day for Fall 2026 is scheduled for Friday, August 28, 2026.
cards.source_title: Campus and Student Life - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Access is restricted to students with valid housing assignments and their families.

cards.title: President's Welcome Lunch
cards.subtitle: Friday Midday Meal
cards.notes: Join the university president for a formal welcome lunch in the Main Dining Room. This is a key opportunity for families to dine together before farewells.
cards.short_summary: A traditional welcome meal for new students and their families hosted by the university president.
cards.evidence_claim: The President's Lunch is held Friday, Aug. 28, 2026, from 11:30 a.m. - 1:30 p.m. in the Campus Center Main Dining Room.
cards.access_notes: Open to new students and their families during orientation weekend.

cards.title: Opening Convocation
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Ceremony
cards.notes: Walk through the Carroll Arch to Shattuck Auditorium for the official academic induction ceremony. This marks the formal beginning of your college career.
cards.short_summary: The formal academic ceremony welcoming the new class to the university community.
cards.evidence_claim: Opening Convocation takes place Friday, Aug. 28, 2026, at 2:45 p.m. starting at the Carroll Arch and moving to Shattuck Auditorium.
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students; families are invited to attend.

cards.title: Family Farewells
cards.subtitle: Friday Late Afternoon
cards.notes: Gather on the Main Lawn for final goodbyes with parents and guests before students transition into their first evening of peer-focused activities.
cards.short_summary: A designated time and place for students to say goodbye to their families.
cards.evidence_claim: Parent and guest farewells are scheduled for 4:00 - 4:15 p.m. on the Main Lawn on Friday of Welcome Week.

cards.title: CU@Night Social
cards.subtitle: Friday Night Entertainment
cards.notes: Head to the Campus Center for late-night entertainment including comedians, DJs, or game nights. These events are designed to help you meet other new students.
cards.short_summary: A late-night social programming series for students held on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.evidence_claim: CU@Night offers free Friday and Saturday night programming such as musicians, DJs, and game nights for Carroll students.
cards.source_title: Things to Do on Campus - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Free for all Carroll students; usually starts in the evening and runs late.

cards.title: Campus Scavenger Hunt
cards.subtitle: Saturday Evening Activity
cards.notes: Participate in a team-based scavenger hunt to learn the layout of the campus and discover important resources while competing for prizes.
cards.short_summary: A fun, interactive way for new students to explore the campus and build teamwork.
cards.evidence_claim: A scavenger hunt evening program is scheduled for Saturday, August 29, 2026, at 7 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open to all first-year students as part of orientation.

cards.title: Orientation Chapel
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Service
cards.notes: Attend an optional interfaith chapel service to reflect on the transition to college life. The chapel is a quiet space for spiritual connection.
cards.short_summary: An optional spiritual service held for students during the orientation weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: An optional Chapel for Orientation event is scheduled for Sunday, August 30, 2026, at 9:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Optional event open to all students.

cards.title: Fire and Ice Social
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Gathering
cards.notes: Enjoy a themed social event featuring treats and music. This is one of the final large-group gatherings before classes begin on Monday.
cards.short_summary: A themed social gathering for new students to celebrate the end of orientation weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Fire and Ice' evening program is scheduled for Sunday, August 30, 2026, from 8 - 10 p.m.

cards.title: RecSports Open House
cards.subtitle: Weekend Recreation
cards.notes: Visit the historic Ganfield Gymnasium to learn about intramural sports, group fitness classes, and equipment rentals like bikes and kayaks.
cards.short_summary: The hub for campus recreation and fitness activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Ganfield Gymnasium hosts free group fitness classes and provides equipment check-out through RecSports.
cards.access_notes: Open to students with a valid Pioneer Card.

cards.title: Downtown Discovery
cards.subtitle: Weekend Off-Campus Walk
cards.notes: Take a short walk to downtown Waukesha to explore local coffee shops, the riverfront trail, and the Saturday morning farmers market.
cards.short_summary: An opportunity for students to explore the local community surrounding the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Carroll is located blocks from downtown Waukesha, which features a farmers market every Saturday morning from May to October.
cards.access_notes: Public city district accessible by walking from campus.
